post.caption: Legend says Cleopatra bet Mark Antony she could spend ten million sesterces on one dinner, then dropped a pearl in vinegar and drank it. The Roman writer Pliny the Elder told the story around 77 AD, about 50 years after she died. In 2010 a classicist at Montclair State University found a one gram pearl took 24 to 36 hours to dissolve in ordinary vinegar, and heat or grinding makes it faster.
